# Step - side_effect

`side_effect` · `sideEffect` · category: [Sack and side effects](../../traversal/step_reference.md#sack-and-side-effects)

Runs the child traversal for its side effects and passes each traverser on unchanged.

## Forms

```text
side_effect(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).side_effect(__.out().aggregate("x")).cap("x").next().len()   // 3
```
